change_reason: v1.3 showed arithmetic, metric-selection, evidence-representation, and retrieval failures. v1.4 holds the seven development questions and local model fixed while connecting actual Docling output and a separately versioned arithmetic-tool QA pipeline. Synap is not a dependency of this research path.

scope.primary_exclusion: financebench_id_00685 remains in all outputs but is excluded only from the primary overall-task denominator because its historical wording and benchmark explanation remain misaligned
scope.retrieval: excluded; every condition receives the frozen source page for the question
scope.claim_boundary: controlled development feasibility evidence; not full RAG performance, independent evaluation, natural parser-error frequency, human repair success, or policy superiority

questions.accepted_conclusion: yes under the benchmark greater-than-one convention

comparison.name: PP-StructureV3
comparison.failure_rule: preserve initialization/inference/serialization failures and continue Docling

text_baselines: PyMuPDF 1.28.2 remains a text/word-coordinate comparison, not a layout parser
parser_contract.canonical_schema: 1.1 with parser-provided table/cell IDs, row/column indices, spans, coordinates, coordinate origins, and parser flags
parser_contract.no_invention: do not synthesize absent labels or coordinates; any row/year/unit association derived from cells is marked as an interpretation

calculator_contract.metric_catalog: generic definitions only: quick ratio, gross margin, percent change, signed-value comparison, direct extraction; kept outside evaluation references
calculator_contract.planner: one LLM call selects metric definition, current-evidence source IDs, row/period/unit interpretations, and an allowed operation graph
calculator_contract.executor: Decimal operations identity, add, subtract, multiply, divide, percent, percent_change, compare, and argmax; unknown IDs, cyclic refs, zero division, invalid units, or unsupported operations fail closed
calculator_contract.answerer: one LLM call receives only the question, validated plan, program result, and selected current-state sources; it must report conclusion, quantitative explanation, calculation, and source IDs
calculator_contract.state_isolation: source values are extracted anew from each current evidence state; clean/evaluation repair values are never available to the calculator

evaluation.failure_rule: failed, empty, malformed, uncited, unsupported, wrong metric, wrong row/year/unit, or unreviewed results are not correct
evaluation.aggregation: report all seven and primary six; never drop parser failures or identical outputs

repair_diagnostic.eligibility: only if Docling canonical AMD p56 contains unambiguous cells for 2022 Cash and cash equivalents=4,835 and Accounts receivable, net=4,126
repair_diagnostic.A: within the matched 2022 Cash and cash equivalents cell, corrupt 4,835 to 835 then restore only for A states
repair_diagnostic.B: within the matched 2022 Accounts receivable, net cell, corrupt 4,126 to 126 then restore only for B states
repair_diagnostic.alternate_route: retain total current assets, inventory, prepaid, and every duplicate or alternative source
repair_diagnostic.freshness: each state reruns planner, calculator, and answerer; no cached no-op response
repair_diagnostic.interpretation: separate parser/calculator effects from verification-repair effects

live_call_budget.stop_rule: do not add prompt variants or calls after observing outputs

preservation.raw: append-only ignored research/work directory; save each input, prompt, raw response or failure, parser raw, canonical, calculation trace, source IDs, runtime identity, manifest, and checksums before aggregation
preservation.tracked: spec, code, compact result table, report, and raw preservation manifest/checksums
preservation.backup: persistent project path is primary; independent physical backup must be reported as verified or unverified

policy_gate.question: parser disagreement and calculator dependency edges may become observable features, but policy comparison remains blocked unless they distinguish error from normal candidates without gold and provide varied downstream overlap
